title: Hidden Currents in the Imperial Court
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji believed everything was under control, a secret letter from the Tianqing Sect quietly made its way into Ling Yuan's hands—the letter contained every single word the nameless strategist had spoken in the teahouse that day.

text.content: While various forces were locked in covert struggle over the Dragon's Vein, a low rumble suddenly echoed from the depths of the imperial forbidden grounds—the sound of an ancient formation sleeping for a millennium being awakened. The sound waves penetrated layers of palace walls, causing subtle tremors on the golden bricks of the Taiji Hall, and the candles on the desk wavered unsteadily, as if the entire imperial capital had held its breath at this very moment. The Crown Prince stood in the hall, his teacup slipping from his hand and shattering sharply against the ground. A flicker of fear crossed his eyes—the abnormal movement of the ancient formation meant the foundation of the empire was trembling, and at this critical juncture, any minor disturbance could become the final straw that breaks the camel's back.

Meanwhile, within the Xuanwu Sect encampment, Han Lie stood with hands clasped behind his back before the sand table, a playful smile playing at the corners of his mouth. Beside him stood a middle-aged man in a python-robed robe—Second Prince Li Chengyan, his brow filled with sinister intent. "Your Highness is truly confident?" Han Lie flicked the flags on the sand table with studied nonchalance. "Although the Crown Prince has fallen from imperial favor, he remains the legitimate successor." Li Chengyan coldly laughed: "Legitimate successor? With His Majesty gravely ill in bed, the Crown Prince's mismanagement of state affairs has caused the ancient formation's disturbance—this is the grand gift I intend to bestow upon him!"

dialogue.content: Young Master Han, did that废物 Chen Ji truly perish within the secret realm?
Dead completely. This one witnessed personally as he was torn apart by demonic beasts, not even a trace remaining.

text.content: Yet before Han Lie could finish speaking, a subtle darkness flickered in the depths of his eyes. That waste's gaze as he faced death had been far too calm—too calm to be despair, more like...mockery. But with greater matters at stake, he quickly cast this lingering doubt aside. After all, what could a废物 who couldn't even break through Foundation Building possibly accomplish?

In an unassuming teahouse on the western outskirts of the capital. Chen Ji had changed into a robe of cyan, his features lightly disguised—appearing as nothing more than an ordinary scholar in his early thirties. He sat composed in the elegant private room, the tea before him long gone cold, yet he was entirely unaware—his mind completely immersed in that faded fragment within the depths of his Mental Sea. The Tianji Record pulsed with gentle warmth, as if presaging something. In three days, it would be the day the Crown Prince faced his palace coup, and he must, before then, place this crucial piece on the board.

dialogue.content: (The voice of the残魂 Guardian resonated from the depths of the Tianji Record, carrying an air of vicissitude) The moment has arrived, but have you truly considered the price?
(Chen Ji laughed lightly within his heart) Merely five points of Heavenly Fate, to exchange for a lever to stir the world—what could be more worthwhile?

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment blazed suddenly, an arcane symbol manifesting above his Brow Center before vanishing. Chen Ji closed his eyes, allowing that inexplicable force to guide him—he saw. Three days hence, in the Taiji Hall, the Crown Prince would be impeached by a hundred officials, isolated and helpless; Han Lie would lead the Xuanwu Sect disciples in formation outside the hall, menacing and aggressive; while Second Prince Li Chengyan would stand upon the crimson steps, assured of victory. Yet, within that chaos, one figure remained hidden in shadow, like a hand beyond the chessboard, quietly manipulating everything...

choice.prompt: Chen Ji, under the identity of the "Nameless Strategist," secretly contacted the Crown Prince's former faction, successfully drawing the attention of the Crown Prince's trusted strategist, Liu Changfeng. Liu Changfeng probed: "Master, with such extraordinary talent, why not meet His Highness the Crown Prince directly?"

choices.description: Directly demonstrate strategic prowess by proposing the three prongs of stabilizing the internal, uniting the external, and crushing the enemy, shocking the other party
choices.visible_reward: Gain the trust of the Crown Prince's former faction
choices.process_label: 亮出底牌，展示真才实学

text.content: Chen Ji lifted his teacup, gently blowing away the curling wisps of steam, his tone unhurried: "To stabilize the internal, His Highness must enter the palace tonight to attend upon His Majesty, using filial piety to silence the whispers of the masses; to unite the external, send a letter to the Governor of Qingzhou, for he is an old ally of His Highness's maternal clan—this move serves as both a gesture of goodwill and a test; as for crushing the enemy—" his eyes flashed brilliantly, "the Second Prince is impatient for quick results, and will surely strike tomorrow during the morning court. At that time, one merely needs to turn his own scheme against him, making him lose his shirt while trying to steal chickens."

dialogue.content: (Shifting his tone, with an enigmatic smile) Of course, these are merely minor tricks. The true killing move that could doom the Second Prince forever can only be discussed in detail upon meeting His Highness.

flags_set: 无名谋士身份_曝光程度_中
choices.memory_label: 无名谋士展现了惊人的洞察力

choices.text: Maintain mystique, leave room for maneuver
choices.description: Only reveal a key piece of information, letting the other party proactively seek an audience with the Crown Prince, increasing one's leverage
choices.visible_cost: The other party may not place enough importance
choices.risk_hint: May miss the opportunity to intervene

text.content: Chen Ji set down his teacup, rose, and walked toward the window, his back to Liu Changfeng: "If His Highness wishes to know the true cause of the ancient formation's disturbance, tonight at the hour of the rat, bring the Crown Prince's token and meet me at the City South Land Temple." His voice was low and certain, "As for the rest—knowing too much may not be a good thing for His Highness."

dialogue.content: (Glancing back with a meaningful smile) By the way, please convey this to His Highness — Xuanwu Sect's Han Lie, this man cannot be trusted.

flags_set: 无名谋士身份_曝光程度_低
choices.memory_label: 无名谋士留下了巨大悬念

choices.text: Reveal the Crown Prince's former subordinates' weaknesses
choices.description: Display the leverage already in hand to force the other party to take you seriously
choices.risk_hint: The other party may act desperately

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly let out a soft laugh, not loud, yet it froze Liu Changfeng in place. "Three years ago, His Highness's deficit — I wonder if Mr. Liu has managed to cover it?" Chen Ji said leisurely, pulling a yellowed receipt from his sleeve and sliding it forward. "If I sent this to the Second Prince, I wonder what His Highness would think?"

dialogue.content: (The smile turns cold) Of course, if Mr. Liu would introduce me to His Highness, this item shall be a meeting gift.

flags_set: 无名谋士身份_曝光程度_高
choices.memory_label: 无名谋士掌握了致命把柄

text.content: Liu Changfeng took the receipt, and his face changed dramatically at a glance. He stared fixedly at this seemingly ordinary scholar in blue robes, his Adam's apple rolling up and down, yet not a single word escaped his lips. That deficit from three years ago was the greatest secret of his life, the fundamental reason he had gambled all his wealth and life on the Crown Prince — if this matter were exposed, not only would Liu Changfeng face execution of his entire clan, but His Highness the Crown Prince would also be implicated.

dialogue.content: No need to be nervous, Mr. Liu.

text.content: Chen Ji sat back down, lifted his teacup, and took a sip, his expression as calm as if the previous words had been mere pleasantries. "If I wanted to harm His Highness, this receipt should have reached the Second Prince's desk three years ago." His gaze越过茶盏的边缘，落在柳长风脸上，"我只是……想让先生知道，与我合作，是殿下目前最好的选择。"茶楼外，暮色渐沉，街上的行人开始稀疏起来。远处隐约传来更鼓声——戌时将过，距离子时，还有两个时辰。"

choice.prompt: Liu Changfeng finally made his decision and agreed to take Chen Ji to meet the Crown Prince. But before setting out, he posed one condition —

choices.description: Agree to Liu Changfeng's request, demonstrate cooperative sincerity
choices.visible_reward: Smoothly enter the Crown Prince's inner circle
choices.risk_hint: May lose the initiative before the Crown Prince

text.content: Chen Ji pondered for a moment, then nodded. "Very well, I shall wait here." He set down his teacup, his gaze平静地望向窗外渐浓的夜色，"不过先生需得快些——子时之前，这座茶楼会来一位不速之客。"他没有说那不速之客是谁，但柳长风莫名觉得背脊发凉。"

choices.description: Point out that Liu Changfeng has no right to negotiate conditions, display a dominant attitude
choices.risk_hint: Liu Changfeng may betray at the last moment

text.content: Chen Ji let out a light laugh, that sound especially jarring in the silent private room. "Does Mr. Liu think he has the qualifications to negotiate with me?" He stood up, looking down at Liu Changfeng from above. "His Highness is beset by troubles within and without, living on borrowed time. And I — am His Highness's sole chance for a comeback." His voice was not loud, yet each word cut like a blade. "If Mr. Liu is unwilling to make introductions, you may certainly go denounce me to the Second Prince now — let's see if he would spare you."

After Liu Changfeng left, Chen Ji sat alone by the window. The tea had long gone cold, yet he had no mind to call the waiter for a fresh pot. Night fell like ink, and the street lamps lit up one by one, illuminating the various figures in this imperial city. He suddenly remembered himself three years ago when he first entered the Tianqing Sect — back then he was still a废物 who couldn't even be detected with spiritual roots, the senior disciples at the servants' peak could beat and scold him as they pleased, and the tasks tossed his way were always the dirtiest and most exhausting. And now...

dialogue.content: (Gently tapping the table, a slight smile playing at the corner of his lips) Han Lie, Han Lie, did you truly believe I died within that secret realm?

text.content: Chen Ji rose from his seat and walked to the bronze mirror. The face reflected there was unfamiliar, yet those eyes still carried that familiar hint of malevolence. He swept his hand across his face, and the disguise came away, revealing the delicate yet pallid visage beneath—the very Chen Ji, the waste of a servant disciple universally acknowledged within the Tianqing Sect. No one could have imagined that this waste was currently standing at the heart of the capital's undercurrents, orchestrating and determining victory from a thousand miles away.

choice.prompt: Just then, a sudden commotion arose outside the teahouse. Chen Ji's brow furrowed—Liu Changfeng had left less than an incense stick's time ago. Who could it be?

choices.description: Maintain mystery, avoid contact with the visitor
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to observe the visitor
choices.risk_hint: The visitor might investigate the teahouse

text.content: Chen Ji didn't hesitate in the slightest. His form flashed and vanished behind the screen in the private room. This teahouse was one he had scouted out three days prior—he knew every hidden door and secret passage by heart. Sliding silently out through the drainage channel of the rear alley, Chen Ji stood upon the eaves and watched from afar as a team of Xuanqing-robed cultivators surrounded the teahouse—their attire, he knew all too well, belonged to the Law Enforcement Hall of the Tianqing Sect.

choices.description: Appear in true form, feigning a chance encounter
choices.visible_reward: Understand the movements of Tianqing Sect

text.content: Chen Ji swiftly reapplied his disguise, changed into an unremarkable rough-cloth garment, and walked brazenly out through the main entrance. At the teahouse entrance, more than a dozen Xuanqing-robed cultivators were interrogating the proprietor. The leader, his face gaunt and his gaze sharp as a blade, was Elder Wu of the Law Enforcement Hall. Chen Ji lowered his head, posing as an ordinary tea customer, and passed indifferently through the crowd.

choices.text: Lurk in the shadows, observe the situation
choices.description: Conceal one's aura, eavesdrop on the visitor's intentions

text.content: Chen Ji收敛全身气息，如同一只蛰伏的毒蛇，悄无声息地攀附在房梁之上。执法堂的人正在盘问掌柜："今日可有一位青衫文人来此？"掌柜战战兢兢地点头："有、有，在二楼雅间……"陈机心头一凛，这帮人竟然是冲着他来的！他屏住呼吸，继续听下去——
那为首的执法堂长老冷声道："根据密报，魔道中人可能假扮成文人模样潜入皇城。凌掌门特意吩咐要加强排查。"他的目光扫过茶楼内每一个角落，"那青衫文人现在何处？"掌柜苦着脸道："被一位客人请走了……"陈机在暗处微微眯眼——凌渊的命令？这老狐狸，果然嗅到了什么。
与此同时，皇城东北角的一处隐秘宅邸中，太子李承平正焦躁不安地来回踱步。他的脸色苍白，眼下乌青，显然已经连续多日没有睡好。古阵异动的消息传来后，二皇子的势力便开始蠢蠢欲动，而父皇的病却迟迟不见起色——他这个太子，当得简直是如坐针毡。"殿下，柳先生回来了。"贴身太监轻声禀报。太子猛地转身："快请！"

dialogue.content: (Kneeling and reporting) Your Highness, this minister today encountered an extraordinary individual. He calls himself 'Nameless,' yet he knows your Highness's current predicament inside out—甚至……even knows about this minister's deficit from three years ago.

text.content: The prince's brow furrowed deeply: 'What is this person's background?' Liu Changfeng shook his head: 'This minister does not know. But the three strategies he proposed, this minister believes... are quite masterful.' He reported Chen Ji's plans one by one, the prince's expression shifting from gravity to astonishment, and finally he actually rose from his seat. 'Did this person truly say that the ancient formation's strange fluctuation is not a calamity, but an opportunity?' Liu Changfeng nodded: 'He said, in crisis lies opportunity—danger contains opportunity within it. As long as your Highness handles it properly, this fluctuation could instead become the key to your Highness's reversal of fortune.'

The Crown Prince was silent for a long while, then suddenly spoke: "Invite him." Liu Changfeng hesitated, "Your Highness, this person's origins are unknown. What if..." The Crown Prince forced a bitter smile: "What if? What do I have left to lose?" His gaze passed through the window lattice, gazing at the distant outline of the imperial capital. "Tomorrow morning's court session, my second brother will make his move. If this Mister Wuming truly is an extraordinary person, I am willing to gamble once. If he belongs to my second brother..." He did not finish, but the determination in his eyes spoke volumes.

dialogue.content: (At the same moment, within the Tianqing Sect's secret chamber) Ling Yuan sat upright on his meditation cushion, an ancient jade slip floating before him. His brow was tightly furrowed, his turbid old eyes flickering with an uneasy light.

text.content: Upon the jade slip, a blurry figure was slowly emerging—a face with indistinct features, yet two eyes were crystal clear, carrying a hint of mocking amusement. Ling Yuan stared at those eyes and suddenly shuddered. That gaze... it was far too familiar. "Chen Ji..." he gritted out through clenched teeth, "You truly are not dead!"

Ling Yuan rose abruptly, waving his sleeve as the stone door of the secret chamber slammed shut. His heart churned with tumultuous waves—three days ago, that corpse torn apart by the demonic beast was merely a decoy! That废物 had not only survived, but had infiltrated the imperial capital, stirring up the wind and clouds from the shadows. What was even more terrifying was that the aura of the Demonic Path Holy Sect also appeared on that false corpse—this meant that the woman named Ye Qing had also participated in this scheme.

"Chen Ji, oh Chen Ji..." Ling Yuan murmured softly, his voice hoarse as if emerging from the depths of hell, "What are you truly scheming?" He slowly closed his eyes, and when he opened them again, those old eyes were already filled with killing intent. "Since you insist on seeking death, this old man shall grant your wish." He brushed his hand across the jade slip, and the blurry face instantly vanished, replaced by a line of icy的文字—"Earth Temple at the Imperial City, the Hour of the Rat."

In the corner of the secret chamber, an eternal lamp flickered now bright now dim, illuminating Ling Yuan's aged and ferocious face. He drew from his bosom a pitch-black token, carved with a bizarre rune—the emblem of the Demonic Path Holy Sect. "Chen Ji, did you think you were the only one who could borrow momentum?" he coldly laughed, "Since the Demonic Path dares to interfere, this old man shall let them know what it means to play with fire!" The token was crushed in his grip, a wisp of black smoke rising from it and vanishing into the void.

At the southwest corner of the Imperial City, a dilapidated Earth Temple appeared especially sinister in the night. The temple was ancient and decaying, walls mottled, the gold paint on the deity's statue long since completely stripped away, only those two eyeballs still gleaming with a faint eerie light. Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back in the temple, enveloped by a layer of faint spiritual light—that was a protective barrier formed automatically after the Tianji Record's aura leaked out. He glanced up at the sky; the Hour of the Rat was approaching.

Footsteps came from outside the temple, unhurried yet deliberate, carrying an air of cautious probing. Chen Ji did not turn around, merely speaking calmly: "Since Your Highness has come, why not enter for a chat?" The footsteps paused, then a young man in civilian attire strode into the temple. He appeared around twenty years old, with sword-like brows and star-bright eyes, his demeanor elegant and noble, his innate dignity impossible to conceal even beneath rough cotton clothing—this was none other than the current Crown Prince, Li Chengping.

dialogue.content: (Turning, clasping hands in salute) This commoner Chen Ji, pays respects to Your Highness.

The Crown Prince examined this mysterious blue-robed scholar before him, a flash of surprise flickering in his eyes—he had expected an elderly white-haired elder, never imagining he would be so young. But immediately, he suppressed the轻视 in his heart and said gravely: "Mister said the ancient formation's agitation was the catalyst; what does that mean?"

text.content: Chen Ji smiled faintly, drawing from his sleeve an ancient and simple token, gently placing it upon the offering table. The token was entirely pitch-black, carved with a profound and mystical rune that radiated a dim glow. "Does Your Highness recognize this object?" The Crown Prince's pupils suddenly contracted—that rune was precisely the Imperial Dragon Vein Seal, passed down as the highest secret of the imperial dynasty, accessible only to successive emperors! "Where... where did you obtain this?" the Crown Prince exclaimed involuntarily.

Chen Ji did not answer directly; instead, he slowly walked to the front of the deity's statue, speaking with his back to the Crown Prince: "The ancient formation's agitation is not a disaster, but a sign of the Dragon Vein's awakening. Three hundred years ago, it was precisely by leveraging the Dragon Vein's power that Emperor Taizu established this magnificent河山." He turned around, gazing intently at the Crown Prince: "And now, the Dragon Vein shall awaken once more. If Your Highness can seize this opportunity..." He paused, the corner of his mouth curving into a meaningful smile: "Then no one in this world shall ever be able to shake Your Highness's position."

The Crown Prince drew a deep breath, struggling to calm his激动的心情. He stared into Chen Ji's eyes, asking word by word: "What does the Mister desire?" Chen Ji laughed lightly, his voice echoing in the empty temple: "What does Your Highness think?" The Crown Prince's brow furrowed: "Power? Wealth? Glory?" Chen Ji shook his head, those eyes glittering with an inexplicable light in the dim illumination. "What this commoner desires, Your Highness cannot give." His voice was low yet resolute: "Therefore, this commoner only needs Your Highness to remember today's agreement—if this commoner should have a request in the future, may Your Highness not forget this night."

The Crown Prince was stunned for a moment, then burst into hearty laughter. "Excellent! Excellent, Mister Wuming!" he applauded in admiration, "I have met countless strategists, yet never one so... intriguing as you." He stepped forward, gazing into Chen Ji's eyes: "Very well, I shall trust you this once. Tomorrow morning at court, you shall accompany me into the palace." Chen Ji bowed slightly: "Many thanks for Your Highness's trust." The corner of his mouth curved into a faint smile, yet in his heart he was secretly calculating—Ling Yuan, since you wish to play, I shall accompany you for a grand game.
